sentences.text: Invitation to discuss a joint SCN2A study
Dear FamilieSCN2A Foundation leadership, we would welcome the opportunity to explore a study together, shaped by your community’s priorities.
SCN2A-related disorders involve gain of function (increased protein activity) or loss of function.
Existing resources include Dragonfly, Simons Searchlight’s registry, natural history study and biorepository, and Citizen Health’s medical-record-based natural history platform.

Studies include Simons Searchlight, remote pediatric SCN2A observation, PRAX-222, PRAX-562, personalized antisense therapy, an epilepsy-dyskinesia survey and natural history registry, and a Pakistani pediatric valproic-acid-response study.
Elsunersen evidence includes a single-patient report and mouse research; its described phase 3 trial is restricted to gain-of-function variants.
Sodium channel blockers have shown benefit in early-onset cases but occasional worsening in later-onset cases; the relutrigine trial excludes loss-of-function variants, limiting generalisation.
We propose jointly refining [study question], with [study approach] developed around community priorities and existing research.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you discuss the idea and how your registry or community could take part with proper consent and ethics approval?
We are not requesting personal information about patients or families.
If welcome, we could arrange an introductory conversation.
